title: Add activation preview view without stage activation
purpose: Expose ecosystem activation planning through TUI as a previewable AgentCore PlanSpec flow, never as direct install or stage activation.
scope: Render activation preview produced by runtime ecosystem planning.
Show affected artifacts, compatibility, policy, rollback and audit expectations.
Require explicit AgentCore run and exact approval for activation side effects.
Show activation blockers from trust, revocation, compatibility or policy.
Prevent stage/install commands from mutating active artifact state.
acceptance_criteria: Activation preview is backed by AgentCore PlanSpec, not TUI-authored side effects.
Stage/install cannot change active artifact set.
Activation blockers are visible before approval.
Rollback handle and audit range expectations are displayed when available.
failure_modes: TUI activates artifacts by stage or install.
Activation preview omits rollback or audit requirements.
